question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the following word.

Forbid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Forbid"** means to refuse to allow (something); to order (someone) not to do something. (मना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The school forbids students from using mobile phones during classes.
 
 
 
• **"Allow"** refers to letting (someone) do something; giving permission for something. (अनुमति देना)
 
 
• **Example: **Parents should allow their children to express their opinions freely.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Forbid'** is **'Allow'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prohibit** (प्रतिबंधित करना): Formally forbid (something) by law, rule, or other authority.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will prohibit smoking in all public places.
 
 
 
• **Call** (बुलाना): To cry out in a loud voice; to summon.
 
 
• **Example:** She called out for help when she saw the fire.
 
 
 
• **Forsake** (त्यागना): To abandon or leave (someone or something).
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to forsake his job to pursue his passion for painting.
